facility.days: Mon, Tue, Wed, Thu, Fri, Sat

provenance.note: Home-based program: street address, phone and provider name are not shown.

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Parent Rights: Parents rights were not included in the parent handbook.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Parent Rights (26 TAC §747.501(9))

occurrences.finding: Sanitation of Building, Grounds and Equipment: In the front outside play area there are potential hazards such as loose bricks, a damage fence on the side of the house, the two entrances gates leading to the street are not secure and are accessible to children. The staircase located on the side of the porch needs to be reattached to the porch to prevent injury to a child.   Additionally, a long nail and sharp pieces of wood were observed in the backyard play area.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Sanitation of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §747.3203)

occurrences.finding: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Separate from Food and Inaccessible: In the front bathroom, shampoo, conditioner, mouthwash, and other toxic household items were made accessible to children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Separate from Food and Inaccessible (26 TAC §747.3203(13))

occurrences.finding: Records Maintained and Made Available - Safety Drills Documentation: Documentation for safety drills, fire extinguishers, smoke and carbon detectors were not made available.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Records Maintained and Made Available - Safety Drills Documentation (26 TAC §747.801(7))

occurrences.finding: Sanitation of Building, Grounds and Equipment: In the front outside play area, a pile of loose wooden boards with nails exposed were made easily accessible to children in care. Additionally, loose bricks were made accessible in the front play area potentially creating trip hazards for the children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Sanitation of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §747.3203)

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: Upon arrival, the children and primary caregiver were in the front outdoor play area where one child was found hiding in the corner standing on a chair behind a crib, another child was seen walking towards the backyard while the caregiver was near the front of the house. During the walkthrough, one child ran towards the back of the home while the primary caregiver was still at the front door letting the other children inside. The 2 year old was seen in the bathroom in the back standing on a toddler tower step stool leaned over the sink in the dark by themselves. Two toddlers were observed by the front door without the caregiver present or nearby. Various times toddlers were seen running through the home without supervision.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §747.1503(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Posting Requirements-Food Allergies Posted Prominently: There is no posting for a child in care with a diagnosed food allergy.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Posting Requirements-Food Allergies Posted Prominently (26 TAC §747.401(b)(1))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information-Completed Food Allergy Emergency Plan: When reviewing records, it was found that a child in care has a diagnosed food allergy with no food allergy emergency plan on file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information-Completed Food Allergy Emergency Plan (26 TAC §747.605(16))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Instructions for Contacting Licensing Office/Online and TX Abuse & Neglect Hotline: In the operation's handbook there are no instructions on how a parent may contact the local Licensing office, access the Texas Abuse and Neglect Hotline, and access the HHSC website.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Instructions for Contacting Licensing Office/Online and TX Abuse & Neglect Hotline (26 TAC §747.501(11))

occurrences.finding: Inspect Fire Extinguishers Monthly: There was no documentation of fire extinguisher inspections for the months of June and July.

Electric or Battery Operated CO System-Document Test Date, Battery Installation Date and Staff Name conducting Testing and Installation: There was no documentation of testing the carbon monoxide detector for the months of June and July.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Electric or Battery Operated CO System-Document Test Date, Battery Installation Date and Staff Name conducting Testing and Installation (26 TAC §747.5337(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Smoke Detectors Testing: There was no documentation for testing the fire alarm for the months of June and July.
